# Crawford Living Realty, LLC

> Crawford Living Realty, LLC is a Florida real estate brokerage serving home buyers and sellers across Central Florida. Its broker and owner is Michael "Mike" Crawford, RENE, CPRES, a Florida real estate broker licensed since 2004.

## Key facts

- Brokerage: Crawford Living Realty, LLC (Florida brokerage license CQ1075533)
- Broker: Michael "Mike" Crawford, RENE, CPRES (Florida broker license BK3074190)
- Licensed in Florida real estate since 2004; his license grew out of years coordinating new-home construction
- Service area: Central Florida, including Orange, Seminole, Osceola, Lake and Volusia counties
- Services: selling a home, buying a home, new construction guidance, and selling a home that is part of an estate (probate)
- Phone: 321-488-5542
- Email: mdc@crawfordliving.com
- Website: https://crawfordliving.com/
